id-20260821-news-2.title: Discussion on Ojol Presidential Regulation Completed, 92:8 Revenue Sharing Scheme Expected to Change the Fate of Millions of Drivers

segments.src: Kabar yang cukup melegakan datang bagi jutaan pengemudi ojek online (ojol) dan kurir di Tanah Air.
segments.tr: Quite relieving news has arrived for millions of online motorcycle taxi (ojol) drivers and couriers in the country.

segments.src: Berdasarkan informasi yang berkembang dari pembahasan antara DPR dan pemerintah, rancangan Peraturan Presiden (Perpres) tentang Perlindungan Pekerja Transportasi Online dikabarkan telah rampung dibahas dan tinggal menunggu proses finalisasi sebelum diterbitkan.
segments.tr: Based on information emerging from discussions between the House of Representatives (DPR) and the government, the draft Presidential Regulation (Perpres) on the Protection of Online Transportation Workers is reported to have finished being discussed and is just waiting for the finalization process before being issued.
## Crucial Point: 92:8 Revenue Sharing Scheme

segments.src: Salah satu substansi yang paling disorot dalam draf Perpres ini adalah ketentuan mengenai skema bagi hasil pendapatan antara pengemudi dan perusahaan aplikasi (aplikator).
segments.tr: One of the most highlighted substances in this draft Presidential Regulation is the provision regarding the revenue sharing scheme between drivers and application companies (applicators).

segments.src: Menurut sejumlah sumber yang mengikuti pembahasan, skema yang disepakati mematok porsi pendapatan pengemudi minimal sebesar 92 persen, sementara aplikator memperoleh potongan maksimal 8 persen dari setiap transaksi.
segments.tr: According to a number of sources following the discussions, the agreed-upon scheme sets the driver's revenue portion at a minimum of 92 percent, while the applicator receives a maximum deduction of 8 percent from each transaction.

segments.src: Jika benar diterapkan, angka ini akan menjadi perubahan signifikan dibandingkan skema potongan yang selama ini berlaku di sejumlah platform, yang menurut keluhan komunitas pengemudi kerap melebihi batas wajar.
segments.tr: If truly implemented, this figure will be a significant change compared to the deduction scheme that has been in effect on a number of platforms, which, according to complaints from the driver community, often exceeds reasonable limits.

segments.src: Wajar jika kabar ini disambut antusias oleh komunitas pengemudi ojol dan kurir di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: It is natural that this news is welcomed with enthusiasm by the ojol and courier driver community in various regions.
## Targeting the Welfare of Millions of Driver Partners

segments.src: Sektor transportasi online telah menjadi tulang punggung ekonomi digital sekaligus sumber penghidupan bagi jutaan keluarga di Indonesia, mulai dari pengemudi roda dua, roda empat, hingga kurir logistik.
segments.tr: The online transportation sector has become the backbone of the digital economy as well as a source of livelihood for millions of families in Indonesia, ranging from two-wheeled drivers, four-wheeled drivers, to logistics couriers.

segments.src: Namun selama bertahun-tahun, status kemitraan yang tidak diatur secara spesifik membuat posisi tawar pengemudi relatif lemah dalam menentukan skema pendapatan maupun perlindungan kerja.
segments.tr: However, for years, the partnership status that was not specifically regulated made the drivers' bargaining position relatively weak in determining revenue schemes or work protection.

segments.src: Kehadiran Perpres ini digadang-gadang bakal menjadi payung hukum yang lebih jelas, tidak hanya soal bagi hasil, tetapi juga berpotensi menyentuh aspek lain seperti perlindungan sosial, standar keselamatan kerja, hingga mekanisme penyelesaian sengketa antara mitra pengemudi dan aplikator.
segments.tr: The presence of this Presidential Regulation is touted to be a clearer legal umbrella, not only regarding revenue sharing, but also potentially touching on other aspects such as social protection, work safety standards, and dispute resolution mechanisms between driver partners and applicators.
## Issuance Timeline Target

segments.src: Berdasarkan perkembangan pembahasan, regulasi ini ditargetkan dapat terbit pada akhir Agustus atau paling lambat awal September 2026.
segments.tr: Based on the progress of the discussions, this regulation is targeted to be issued at the end of August or at the latest by early September 2026.

segments.src: Meski demikian, publik tentu masih perlu menantikan rilis resmi dari pemerintah karena proses harmonisasi dan finalisasi sebuah peraturan presiden dapat berubah sewaktu-waktu mengikuti dinamika pembahasan lintas kementerian dan lembaga.
segments.tr: Nevertheless, the public certainly still needs to wait for the official release from the government because the harmonization and finalization process of a presidential regulation can change at any time following the dynamics of discussions across ministries and institutions.
## Response from Various Parties

segments.src: Kabar ini turut memantik beragam respons.
segments.tr: This news has also sparked various responses.

segments.src: Komunitas pengemudi ojol menyambut positif karena dinilai dapat memberikan kepastian pendapatan yang lebih layak.
segments.tr: The ojol driver community welcomes it positively because it is considered to be able to provide more decent income certainty.

segments.src: Di sisi lain, sejumlah kalangan mengingatkan pentingnya masa transisi yang matang agar perusahaan aplikator seperti Gojek, Grab, Maxim, dan platform sejenis tetap dapat menjaga keberlangsungan bisnis sambil beradaptasi dengan ketentuan baru tersebut.
segments.tr: On the other hand, a number of parties have reminded of the importance of a mature transition period so that applicator companies such as Gojek, Grab, Maxim, and similar platforms can still maintain business continuity while adapting to these new provisions.

segments.src: Sejumlah pengamat ekonomi digital menilai keseimbangan antara kesejahteraan pengemudi dan keberlanjutan model bisnis aplikator menjadi kunci agar regulasi ini benar-benar efektif diterapkan, bukan sekadar aturan di atas kertas.
segments.tr: A number of digital economy observers assess that the balance between driver welfare and the sustainability of the applicator's business model is the key for this regulation to be truly effectively implemented, not just a rule on paper.
## What Needs to be Paid Attention to Next

segments.src: Publik, khususnya para pengemudi ojol dan kurir, disarankan untuk terus memantau perkembangan resmi dari pemerintah maupun DPR terkait detail final Perpres ini.
segments.tr: The public, especially ojol drivers and couriers, are advised to continue monitoring official developments from the government and the DPR regarding the final details of this Presidential Regulation.

segments.src: Sebab, sampai peraturan tersebut benar-benar diundangkan, sejumlah ketentuan teknis seperti masa transisi penerapan, mekanisme pengawasan, hingga sanksi bagi pelanggaran skema bagi hasil masih berpotensi mengalami penyesuaian.
segments.tr: Because, until the regulation is truly enacted, a number of technical provisions such as the transition period for implementation, supervision mechanisms, and sanctions for violations of the revenue sharing scheme still have the potential to undergo adjustments.

segments.src: Jika target waktu terpenuhi, Perpres ini berpeluang menjadi salah satu regulasi paling dinanti sepanjang 2026 bagi ekosistem transportasi online di Indonesia, sekaligus menjadi indikator penting bagaimana negara hadir dalam melindungi pekerja di sektor ekonomi digital yang terus bertumbuh.
segments.tr: If the target time is met, this Presidential Regulation has the opportunity to become one of the most anticipated regulations throughout 2026 for the online transportation ecosystem in Indonesia, as well as an important indicator of how the state is present in protecting workers in the continuously growing digital economy sector.

id-20260821-news-1.title: Indonesian Credit Card Officially Launched, Transactions Now Fully Processed via Domestic Infrastructure

segments.tr: ## A New Chapter for the National Payment System

segments.src: Industri pembayaran Indonesia mencatat tonggak baru setelah Bank Indonesia (BI) bersama Asosiasi Sistem Pembayaran Indonesia (ASPI) memperkenalkan **Kartu Kredit Indonesia (KKI)**, skema kartu kredit yang seluruh proses transaksinya diklaim dapat ditangani melalui infrastruktur pembayaran domestik.
segments.tr: The Indonesian payment industry has marked a new milestone after Bank Indonesia (BI), together with the Indonesian Payment System Association (ASPI), introduced the **Indonesian Credit Card (KKI)**, a credit card scheme where all transaction processes are claimed to be handled through domestic payment infrastructure.

segments.src: Langkah ini melanjutkan arah kebijakan yang selama ini dibangun lewat QRIS (Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard), yang telah lebih dulu memungkinkan transaksi nontunai berbasis kode QR diproses di dalam negeri.
segments.tr: This step continues the policy direction that has been built through QRIS (Quick Response Code Indonesian Standard), which previously enabled QR code-based non-cash transactions to be processed domestically.

segments.src: Kehadiran KKI menandai perluasan cakupan sistem pembayaran nasional dari sekadar transaksi debit dan uang elektronik, ke ranah kartu kredit yang selama ini identik dengan jaringan pembayaran internasional.
segments.tr: The presence of KKI marks the expansion of the national payment system's scope from merely debit and electronic money transactions to the realm of credit cards, which have long been synonymous with international payment networks.
## How This Scheme Works

segments.src: Berbeda dari kartu kredit konvensional yang lazimnya mengandalkan jaringan prosesor global, transaksi pada Kartu Kredit Indonesia dirancang agar dapat dirampungkan melalui jalur QRIS dan infrastruktur switching domestik.
segments.tr: Unlike conventional credit cards that typically rely on global processor networks, transactions on the Indonesian Credit Card are designed to be completed through QRIS channels and domestic switching infrastructure.

segments.src: Secara sederhana, proses otorisasi, kliring, hingga penyelesaian transaksi berlangsung di dalam ekosistem pembayaran nasional.
segments.tr: Simply put, the processes of authorization, clearing, and settlement of transactions take place within the national payment ecosystem.

segments.src: Pendekatan ini sejalan dengan semangat besar Blueprint Sistem Pembayaran Indonesia yang selama ini didorong BI, yakni memperkuat kemandirian, efisiensi, dan keamanan data transaksi masyarakat Indonesia tanpa harus sepenuhnya bergantung pada infrastruktur pihak luar.
segments.tr: This approach aligns with the grand vision of the Indonesian Payment System Blueprint that has been promoted by BI, namely to strengthen the independence, efficiency, and security of Indonesian public transaction data without having to rely entirely on external infrastructure.

segments.src: ## Delapan Bank Jadi Penyedia Tahap Awal
segments.tr: ## Eight Banks Become Initial Providers

segments.src: Pada tahap peluncuran awal, sejumlah bank besar nasional dilaporkan turut serta sebagai penyedia layanan KKI, termasuk **Bank Central Asia (BCA)**, **Bank Mandiri**, **Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI)**, dan **Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI)**, bersama beberapa bank lain yang melengkapi delapan peserta pada gelombang pertama ini.
segments.tr: In the initial launch phase, several major national banks are reported to be participating as KKI service providers, including **Bank Central Asia (BCA)**, **Bank Mandiri**, **Bank Negara Indonesia (BNI)**, and **Bank Rakyat Indonesia (BRI)**, along with several other banks that complete the eight participants in this first wave.

segments.src: Keikutsertaan bank-bank pelat merah maupun swasta besar tersebut diharapkan mempercepat adopsi KKI di kalangan nasabah, mengingat basis pemegang kartu dan jaringan merchant dari bank-bank tersebut sudah cukup luas di berbagai daerah.
segments.tr: The participation of these state-owned and major private banks is expected to accelerate the adoption of KKI among customers, given that the cardholder base and merchant networks of these banks are already quite extensive in various regions.
## Benefits Offered

segments.src: Beberapa nilai tambah yang kerap disorot dari skema pemrosesan domestik seperti ini antara lain:
segments.tr: Some of the added values often highlighted from such domestic processing schemes include:

segments.src: - **Kedaulatan data transaksi** — data pembayaran masyarakat Indonesia dapat diproses dan disimpan dalam ekosistem dalam negeri.
segments.tr: - **Transaction data sovereignty** — payment data of the Indonesian public can be processed and stored within the domestic ecosystem.

segments.src: - **Potensi biaya transaksi yang lebih kompetitif** — karena tidak seluruhnya bergantung pada skema fee jaringan internasional.
segments.tr: - **Potential for more competitive transaction fees** — because it does not rely entirely on international network fee schemes.

segments.src: - **Interoperabilitas dengan QRIS** — memudahkan integrasi dengan merchant yang sudah terbiasa menerima pembayaran berbasis QR.
segments.tr: - **Interoperability with QRIS** — facilitating integration with merchants already accustomed to accepting QR-based payments.

segments.src: - **Dukungan terhadap UMKM** — mempermudah pelaku usaha kecil mengakses sistem pembayaran kartu tanpa harus bergantung pada infrastruktur berbiaya tinggi.
segments.tr: - **Support for MSMEs** — making it easier for small business owners to access card payment systems without having to rely on high-cost infrastructure.
## Next Steps

segments.src: BI dan ASPI disebut akan terus mengevaluasi perluasan cakupan KKI, baik dari sisi jumlah bank penerbit, jenis merchant yang dapat menerima pembayaran, maupun fitur tambahan bagi nasabah.
segments.tr: BI and ASPI are said to continue evaluating the expansion of KKI's scope, both in terms of the number of issuing banks, the types of merchants that can accept payments, and additional features for customers.

segments.src: Sebagaimana lazimnya inisiatif infrastruktur pembayaran baru, adopsi di lapangan kemungkinan berjalan bertahap seiring proses sosialisasi kepada bank, merchant, dan masyarakat.
segments.tr: As is typical with new payment infrastructure initiatives, adoption in the field will likely proceed gradually in line with the socialization process for banks, merchants, and the public.

segments.src: Bagi nasabah maupun pelaku usaha yang tertarik menggunakan layanan ini, disarankan untuk memantau informasi resmi dari bank penerbit masing-masing serta kanal resmi Bank Indonesia guna mendapatkan detail syarat, ketentuan, dan jadwal ketersediaan layanan yang paling mutakhir.
segments.tr: For customers and business owners interested in using this service, it is recommended to monitor official information from their respective issuing banks as well as official Bank Indonesia channels to obtain the most up-to-date details on terms, conditions, and service availability schedules.

segments.src: *Artikel ini disusun untuk tujuan informasi umum dan bukan merupakan saran keuangan atau ajakan bertransaksi pada produk tertentu.*
segments.tr: *This article is compiled for general information purposes and does not constitute financial advice or an invitation to transact in any specific product.*

id-20260821-news-3.title: KPK Confirms State Loss of Rp622 Billion in Alleged 2023-2024 Ministry of Religious Affairs Hajj Quota Scandal

segments.src: Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) menegaskan bahwa angka kerugian negara sebesar Rp622 miliar dalam perkara dugaan korupsi terkait pembagian kuota dan penyelenggaraan ibadah haji di lingkungan Kementerian Agama (Kemenag) periode 2023-2024 bukan merupakan klaim sepihak dari penyidik.
segments.tr: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) emphasized that the state loss figure of Rp622 billion in the alleged corruption case related to the distribution of quotas and the organization of the Hajj pilgrimage within the Ministry of Religious Affairs (Kemenag) for the 2023-2024 period is not a unilateral claim by investigators.

segments.src: Penegasan ini disampaikan seiring berkas perkara yang kian mendekati tahap pelimpahan ke pengadilan.
segments.tr: This affirmation was conveyed as the case file nears the stage of submission to the court.
## Loss Figures Based on Independent Audit

segments.src: Menurut keterangan tim penyidik, perhitungan kerugian negara dalam kasus ini tidak disusun sendiri oleh KPK, melainkan melibatkan auditor dari Badan Pemeriksa Keuangan (BPK) sebagai pihak yang berwenang melakukan penghitungan kerugian keuangan negara secara independen.
segments.tr: According to the investigation team, the calculation of state losses in this case was not compiled by the KPK alone, but involved auditors from the Audit Board of the Republic of Indonesia (BPK) as the party authorized to independently calculate state financial losses.

segments.src: Pelibatan BPK dimaksudkan agar angka yang dijadikan dasar dakwaan memiliki landasan metodologi yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan secara hukum maupun akuntansi, sekaligus menepis anggapan bahwa nilai kerugian tersebut hanya merupakan estimasi sepihak dari tim penyidik.
segments.tr: The involvement of the BPK is intended to ensure that the figures used as the basis for the indictment have a methodological foundation that can be accounted for legally and in terms of accounting, while also dismissing the assumption that the loss value is merely a unilateral estimate by the investigation team.

segments.src: Dugaan penyimpangan yang menjadi fokus penyidikan berkaitan dengan proses pembagian kuota tambahan haji serta sejumlah aspek dalam penyelenggaraan ibadah haji yang berlangsung pada periode 2023 hingga 2024.
segments.tr: The alleged irregularities that are the focus of the investigation relate to the process of distributing additional Hajj quotas as well as several aspects of the organization of the Hajj pilgrimage that took place in the 2023 to 2024 period.

segments.src: KPK menyebut bahwa proses penghitungan kerugian negara tersebut melalui tahapan pemeriksaan dokumen, verifikasi data keuangan, hingga klarifikasi kepada pihak-pihak terkait sebelum angka final ditetapkan.
segments.tr: The KPK stated that the process of calculating the state losses went through stages of document examination, financial data verification, and clarification with relevant parties before the final figure was determined.
## Case File Nearing Submission Stage

segments.src: Sumber di internal KPK menyampaikan bahwa proses penyidikan kasus ini telah memasuki tahap akhir, dengan berkas perkara yang tengah disiapkan untuk dilimpahkan ke tahap penuntutan.
segments.tr: Sources within the KPK stated that the investigation process for this case has entered its final stage, with the case file being prepared for submission to the prosecution stage.

segments.src: Kelengkapan berkas, termasuk hasil audit kerugian negara dari BPK, disebut menjadi salah satu syarat penting sebelum perkara dapat dibawa ke persidangan.
segments.tr: The completeness of the file, including the results of the state loss audit from the BPK, is said to be one of the important requirements before the case can be brought to trial.

segments.src: KPK menyatakan pihaknya akan terus melengkapi alat bukti serta memastikan setiap unsur pidana dalam perkara ini terpenuhi sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku, sebelum berkas dinyatakan lengkap (P-21) dan diserahkan kepada jaksa penuntut umum.
segments.tr: The KPK stated that it will continue to complete the evidence and ensure that every criminal element in this case is met in accordance with applicable regulations, before the file is declared complete (P-21) and handed over to the public prosecutor.
## Ongoing Legal Process

segments.src: Perlu digarisbawahi bahwa kasus ini masih berada dalam proses hukum yang berjalan, dan pihak-pihak yang diduga terlibat berhak atas asas praduga tak bersalah hingga adanya putusan pengadilan yang berkekuatan hukum tetap.
segments.tr: It should be underlined that this case is still in an ongoing legal process, and the parties suspected of being involved are entitled to the presumption of innocence until there is a court decision with permanent legal force.

segments.src: KPK maupun Kemenag hingga saat ini belum merilis rincian lengkap mengenai identitas seluruh pihak yang berstatus tersangka maupun mekanisme detail dugaan penyimpangan dalam pembagian kuota haji tersebut.
segments.tr: The KPK and the Ministry of Religious Affairs have not yet released full details regarding the identities of all parties with suspect status or the detailed mechanisms of the alleged irregularities in the distribution of the Hajj quota.

segments.src: Kementerian Agama sendiri menyatakan komitmennya untuk kooperatif dengan proses hukum yang sedang berjalan serta mendukung upaya perbaikan tata kelola penyelenggaraan ibadah haji ke depan, termasuk dalam hal transparansi pembagian kuota.
segments.tr: The Ministry of Religious Affairs itself has stated its commitment to be cooperative with the ongoing legal process and to support efforts to improve the governance of Hajj pilgrimage organization in the future, including in terms of transparency in quota distribution.

segments.src: ## Dampak terhadap Tata Kelola Haji ke Depan
segments.tr: ## Impact on Future Hajj Governance

segments.src: Kasus ini menjadi sorotan publik mengingat besarnya jumlah jemaah haji Indonesia setiap tahunnya serta dana yang dikelola dalam penyelenggaraannya.
segments.tr: This case has become a public spotlight given the large number of Indonesian Hajj pilgrims each year and the funds managed in its organization.

segments.src: Sejumlah pihak berharap proses hukum yang transparan dapat mendorong perbaikan sistem pengawasan kuota haji agar kejadian serupa tidak terulang di masa mendatang.
segments.tr: Several parties hope that a transparent legal process can encourage improvements in the Hajj quota supervision system so that similar incidents do not recur in the future.

segments.src: Publik kini menantikan langkah selanjutnya dari KPK, khususnya terkait siapa saja yang akan didakwa serta bagaimana proses persidangan akan mengungkap secara rinci kronologi dugaan penyimpangan yang menyebabkan kerugian negara dalam jumlah signifikan tersebut.
segments.tr: The public is now awaiting the next steps from the KPK, particularly regarding who will be charged and how the trial process will reveal in detail the chronology of the alleged irregularities that caused such a significant amount of state loss.

id-20260821-intro-agriculture-3.title: [Agronomy #3] Soil Is Not Just "Dirt": Reading the Layers and Properties Beneath Our Feet

segments.src: > Tanah adalah campuran mineral, bahan organik, air, dan udara yang tersusun berlapis — memahami tekstur, struktur, dan sifat kimianya adalah langkah pertama sebelum menanam apa pun.
segments.tr: > Soil is a mixture of minerals, organic matter, water, and air arranged in layers — understanding its texture, structure, and chemical properties is the first step before planting anything.

segments.src: ## Oday's konsep — Oh, maksudnya: Konsep Hari Ini
segments.tr: ## Oday's konsep — Oh, I mean: Today's Concept

segments.src: Kalau Anda menggenggam segenggam tanah kebun, sebenarnya yang Anda pegang itu empat hal sekaligus.
segments.tr: If you hold a handful of garden soil, you are actually holding four things at once.

segments.src: Secara umum, tanah pertanian yang sehat kira-kira terdiri dari **45% bahan mineral** (pecahan batuan), **5% bahan organik** (sisa daun, akar, mikroba), **25% air**, dan **25% udara**.
segments.tr: In general, healthy agricultural soil consists of roughly **45% mineral matter** (rock fragments), **5% organic matter** (leaf litter, roots, microbes), **25% water**, and **25% air**.

segments.src: Dua yang terakhir menempati ruang pori — celah kosong antar butiran.
segments.tr: The latter two occupy pore spaces — the empty gaps between grains.

segments.src: Tanaman tidak hidup dari butiran tanah; ia hidup dari air dan udara yang tersimpan di celah-celah itu.
segments.tr: Plants do not live off soil grains; they live off the water and air stored in those gaps.
### 1. Soil texture (tekstur/soil texture)

segments.src: Tekstur adalah **perbandingan ukuran butiran mineral**, dan ini sifat yang hampir tidak bisa Anda ubah seumur hidup lahan.
segments.tr: Texture is the **ratio of mineral grain sizes**, and this is a property you can almost never change in a field's lifetime.
There are three fractions:
| Fraction | Size | Feel when handled |
| Sand | 2 – 0.05 mm | Rough, gritty |
| Silt | 0.05 – 0.002 mm | Smooth like flour |

segments.src: | Liat (clay) | < 0,002 mm | Lengket, licin saat basah |
segments.tr: | Clay | < 0.002 mm | Sticky, slippery when wet |

segments.src: Kombinasinya menghasilkan **kelas tekstur**, misalnya lempung (loam), lempung berpasir, atau liat berat.
segments.tr: Their combination produces **texture classes**, such as loam, sandy loam, or heavy clay.

segments.src: Tekstur ideal untuk kebanyakan tanaman adalah **lempung** — cukup pasir agar air lebih mudah lewat, cukup liat agar hara tertahan.
segments.tr: The ideal texture for most plants is **loam** — enough sand for water to pass through easily, enough clay to retain nutrients.

segments.src: Kenapa liat begitu penting meski ukurannya paling kecil?
segments.tr: Why is clay so important even though its size is the smallest?

segments.src: Karena **luas permukaan per gram**-nya sangat besar dan permukaannya bermuatan negatif.
segments.tr: Because its **surface area per gram** is huge and its surface carries a negative charge.

segments.src: Muatan itulah yang "memegang" hara bermuatan positif seperti kalium dan kalsium.
segments.tr: That charge is what "holds" positively charged nutrients like potassium and calcium.
### 2. Soil profile (profil/soil profile)

segments.src: Kalau Anda menggali lubang sedalam satu-dua meter dan melihat dinding lubangnya, Anda akan melihat lapisan-lapisan berbeda warna.
segments.tr: If you dig a hole one to two meters deep and look at the walls, you will see layers of different colors.
These are called **horizons**:

segments.src: O  - lapisan serasah, daun-daun busuk di permukaan
segments.tr: O  - lapisan serasah, daun-daun busuk di permukaan

segments.src: A  - topsoil, gelap, kaya bahan organik, tempat akar bekerja
segments.tr: A  - topsoil, gelap, kaya bahan organik, tempat akar bekerja

segments.src: E  - lapisan tercuci (tidak selalu ada), warnanya pucat
segments.tr: E  - lapisan tercuci (tidak selalu ada), warnanya pucat

segments.src: B  - subsoil, tempat liat dan hara hasil cucian mengendap
segments.tr: B  - subsoil, tempat liat dan hara hasil cucian mengendap

segments.src: C  - bahan induk, batuan yang sudah lapuk sebagian
segments.tr: C  - bahan induk, batuan yang sudah lapuk sebagian

segments.src: R  - batuan induk yang masih utuh
segments.tr: R  - batuan induk yang masih utuh
Horizon A is a farmer's "treasure."

segments.src: Tebalnya sering hanya 15–30 cm, dan butuh ratusan tahun untuk terbentuk — tapi bisa hilang dalam beberapa musim hujan kalau lahan dibiarkan terbuka di lereng.
segments.tr: It is often only 15–30 cm thick and takes hundreds of years to form — but it can wash away in a few rainy seasons if the land is left bare on a slope.
### 3. Physical properties

segments.src: - **Struktur tanah**: bagaimana butiran pasir/debu/liat saling menempel jadi gumpalan (agregat). Berbeda dari tekstur, struktur **bisa diperbaiki** — dengan kompos, pupuk kandang, atau tanaman penutup. Struktur remah (granular) adalah yang terbaik untuk perakaran.
segments.tr: - **Soil structure**: how sand/silt/clay grains stick together to form clumps (aggregates). Unlike texture, structure **can be improved** — with compost, manure, or cover crops. Granular structure is the best for root growth.

segments.src: - **Porositas**: persentase ruang pori. Pori besar (makropori) mengalirkan air; pori kecil (mikropori) menyimpannya.
segments.tr: - **Porosity**: the percentage of pore space. Large pores (macropores) drain water; small pores (micropores) store it.

segments.src: - **Bulk density** (kerapatan lindak): berat tanah kering per satuan volume, ditulis `BD = massa kering / volume total`. Tanah lempung sehat sekitar 1,1–1,4 g/cm³. Kalau sudah di atas ~1,6 g/cm³, akar mulai kesulitan menembus — itu tanda pemadatan.
segments.tr: - **Bulk density**: the dry weight of soil per unit volume, written as `BD = dry mass / total volume`. Healthy loam soil is around 1.1–1.4 g/cm³. Once it is above ~1.6 g/cm³, roots begin to struggle to penetrate — that is a sign of compaction.

segments.src: - **Daya pegang air**: selisih antara kondisi *kapasitas lapang* (setelah air gravitasi habis mengalir) dan *titik layu permanen* (air tersisa tapi akar tak sanggup menariknya). Selisih inilah air yang benar-benar tersedia bagi tanaman.
segments.tr: - **Water holding capacity**: the difference between *field capacity* (after gravitational water has drained away) and the *permanent wilting point* (water remains but roots cannot pull it). This difference is the water actually available to plants.
### 4. Chemical properties

segments.src: - **pH tanah**: ukuran kemasaman, skala 0–14. Sebagian besar tanaman pangan tumbuh optimal pada pH 6,0–7,0. Banyak tanah di daerah tropis basah bersifat **masam** (pH 4,5–5,5) karena hujan tinggi mencuci kalsium dan magnesium. Pada pH rendah, aluminium menjadi larut dan meracuni akar, sementara fosfor jadi terikat dan sulit diserap.
segments.tr: - **Soil pH**: a measure of acidity, on a 0–14 scale. Most food crops grow optimally at pH 6.0–7.0. Many soils in humid tropical regions are **acidic** (pH 4.5–5.5) because high rainfall leaches away calcium and magnesium. At low pH, aluminum becomes soluble and poisons roots, while phosphorus becomes bound and difficult to absorb.

segments.src: - **KTK (Kapasitas Tukar Kation / CEC)**: kemampuan tanah menahan hara bermuatan positif. Makin tinggi kandungan liat dan bahan organik, makin tinggi KTK, makin "awet" pupuk yang Anda tabur.
segments.tr: - **CEC (Cation Exchange Capacity)**: the ability of soil to retain positively charged nutrients. The higher the clay and organic matter content, the higher the CEC, and the longer the fertilizer you apply will last.

segments.src: - **Bahan organik**: bukan hanya sumber hara, tapi juga perekat agregat dan spons penyimpan air. Menaikkannya 1% saja sudah terasa efeknya pada ketahanan lahan terhadap kemarau.
segments.tr: - **Organic matter**: not only a source of nutrients, but also an aggregate binder and water-storing sponge. Increasing it by just 1% has a noticeable effect on the land's drought resilience.

segments.src: Jadi rumus praktisnya: **tekstur menentukan potensi bawaan lahan, struktur dan kimia menentukan seberapa jauh Anda bisa mengoptimalkannya.**
segments.tr: So the practical formula is: **texture determines the land's inherent potential, while structure and chemistry determine how far you can optimize it.**
## In Daily Life

segments.src: Bayangkan Pak Yanto punya dua petak lahan: satu di dataran tinggi Lembang, Jawa Barat, satu lagi warisan di dekat Karawang.
segments.tr: Imagine Pak Yanto has two plots of land: one in the highlands of Lembang, West Java, and another inherited near Karawang.

segments.src: Lahan Lembang berasal dari abu vulkanik Gunung Tangkuban Perahu — teksturnya lempung berdebu, gembur, warna gelap, bahan organik tinggi.
segments.tr: The Lembang land originates from the volcanic ash of Mount Tangkuban Perahu — its texture is silty loam, loose, dark in color, with high organic matter.

segments.src: Ketika dipegang basah, ia menggumpal lalu hancur remah.
segments.tr: When held while wet, it clumps and then crumbles easily.

segments.src: Air hujan meresap cepat, tapi tidak habis lolos.
segments.tr: Rainwater infiltrates quickly, but does not drain away completely.
Carrots and potatoes grow well there.

segments.src: Namun karena lahannya miring dan hujan deras, horizon A-nya rawan tergerus; Pak Yanto perlu membuat teras dan menanam rumput di guludan.
segments.tr: However, because the land is sloped and heavy rains occur, horizon A is prone to erosion; Pak Yanto needs to build terraces and plant grass on the ridges.

segments.src: Lahan Karawang berbeda: sawah dataran rendah dengan liat berat.
segments.tr: The Karawang land is different: a lowland paddy field with heavy clay.

segments.src: Saat kemarau, tanah itu retak-retak selebar jari; saat hujan, becek dan lengket di sandal.
segments.tr: During the dry season, the soil cracks wide as a finger; during the rainy season, it is muddy and sticks to sandals.

segments.src: Untuk padi sawah, sifat ini justru **menguntungkan** — liat menahan genangan sehingga air tidak cepat hilang, dan KTK-nya tinggi sehingga pupuk urea tidak langsung tercuci.
segments.tr: For wetland paddy, this property is actually **advantageous** — the clay retains standing water so it doesn't drain too quickly, and its high CEC prevents urea fertilizer from washing away immediately.

segments.src: Tapi kalau Pak Yanto nekat menanam bawang merah di situ tanpa bedengan tinggi, umbinya akan busuk karena drainase buruk dan udara di zona akar habis.
segments.tr: But if Pak Yanto recklessly plants shallots there without high beds, the bulbs will rot due to poor drainage and a lack of oxygen in the root zone.

segments.src: Lalu ia mengirim sampel ke laboratorium tanah — biayanya berkisar Rp150.000–Rp400.000 per sampel untuk paket dasar di banyak lab BPTP atau universitas.
segments.tr: Then he sends a sample to a soil laboratory — the cost ranges from Rp150,000 to Rp400,000 per sample for a basic package at many BPTP or university labs.

segments.src: Hasilnya: pH lahan Karawang 5,2 dan KTK sedang.
segments.tr: The result: the Karawang soil pH is 5.2 and CEC is moderate.

segments.src: Rekomendasinya pengapuran dengan dolomit, sekitar 1–2 ton per hektare tergantung kejenuhan aluminium.
segments.tr: The recommendation is liming with dolomite, about 1–2 tons per hectare depending on aluminum saturation.

segments.src: Dengan harga dolomit di kisaran Rp900.000–Rp1.500.000 per ton, ini investasi sekali yang efeknya bertahan beberapa musim — jauh lebih murah daripada terus menambah pupuk yang tidak terserap karena pH-nya salah.
segments.tr: With dolomite prices ranging from Rp900,000 to Rp1,500,000 per ton, this is a one-time investment whose effects last several seasons — much cheaper than constantly adding fertilizer that isn't absorbed because the pH is wrong.

segments.src: Pelajarannya: **tidak ada tanah "jelek", yang ada adalah tanaman yang salah tempat.** Liat berat adalah bencana untuk bawang, tapi berkah untuk padi.
segments.tr: The lesson: **there is no "bad" soil, only plants in the wrong place.** Heavy clay is a disaster for shallots, but a blessing for rice.
## 3-Line Summary

segments.src: 1. Tanah adalah campuran mineral, bahan organik, air, dan udara; tekstur (proporsi pasir–debu–liat) adalah sifat bawaan yang hampir tak bisa diubah, sedangkan struktur bisa diperbaiki dengan bahan organik.
segments.tr: 1. Soil is a mixture of minerals, organic matter, water, and air; texture (the proportion of sand–silt–clay) is an inherent property that is almost unchangeable, whereas structure can be improved with organic matter.

segments.src: 2. Profil tanah tersusun dalam horizon O–A–B–C–R, dan horizon A (topsoil) yang hanya setebal belasan sentimeter adalah lapisan paling produktif sekaligus paling mudah hilang oleh erosi.
segments.tr: 2. The soil profile is arranged into horizons O–A–B–C–R, and horizon A (topsoil), which is only a dozen centimeters thick, is the most productive layer as well as the most easily lost to erosion.

segments.src: 3. Sifat kimia — terutama pH dan KTK — menentukan apakah hara yang ada benar-benar bisa diserap akar; di daerah tropis basah, tanah masam adalah masalah paling umum.
segments.tr: 3. Chemical properties — especially pH and CEC — determine whether existing nutrients can actually be absorbed by roots; in humid tropical regions, acidic soil is the most common problem.

segments.tr: **1.** Which of the following is a **soil property that is practically unchangeable** by farmers?
- A. Soil structure
- B. Soil texture
- C. Organic matter content
- D. Soil pH

segments.src: **2.** Horizon yang biasa disebut *topsoil*, berwarna gelap dan paling kaya bahan organik, adalah horizon B.
segments.tr: **2.** The horizon commonly called *topsoil*, dark in color and richest in organic matter, is horizon B.

segments.src: **3.** Tanah dengan pH 5,0 di daerah tropis basah umumnya menghadapi masalah berikut, KECUALI:
segments.tr: **3.** Soil with a pH of 5.0 in a humid tropical region generally faces the following problems, EXCEPT:

segments.src: - A. Aluminium larut dan meracuni akar
segments.tr: - A. Aluminum dissolves and poisons roots

segments.src: - B. Fosfor terikat sehingga sulit diserap
segments.tr: - B. Phosphorus is bound making it difficult to absorb

segments.src: - C. Kalsium dan magnesium tercuci oleh hujan
segments.tr: - C. Calcium and magnesium are leached by rain

## 📚 Term of the Day

segments.src: - **Tekstur tanah** — Perbandingan proporsi pasir, debu, dan liat dalam tanah; menentukan kelas tanah seperti lempung atau liat.
segments.tr: - **Soil texture** — The ratio of sand, silt, and clay proportions in the soil; determines soil classes such as loam or clay.

segments.src: - **Struktur tanah** — Cara butiran tanah saling menempel membentuk agregat; memengaruhi aerasi dan penetrasi akar, dan dapat diperbaiki.
segments.tr: - **Soil structure** — How soil grains stick together to form aggregates; affects aeration and root penetration, and can be improved.

segments.src: - **Horizon** — Lapisan tanah yang berbeda warna dan sifat, terlihat pada penampang vertikal (profil) tanah.
segments.tr: - **Horizon** — Soil layers with different colors and properties, visible in a vertical cross-section (profile) of the soil.

segments.src: - **KTK (Kapasitas Tukar Kation)** — Kemampuan tanah menahan dan mempertukarkan hara bermuatan positif; makin tinggi, makin awet pupuk yang diberikan.
segments.tr: - **CEC (Cation Exchange Capacity)** — The ability of soil to retain and exchange positively charged nutrients; the higher it is, the longer applied fertilizers last.

segments.src: - **Kapasitas lapang** — Kondisi kadar air tanah setelah air gravitasi selesai mengalir keluar; batas atas air yang tersedia bagi tanaman.
segments.tr: - **Field capacity** — The condition of soil moisture content after gravitational water has finished draining out; the upper limit of water available to plants.
*Answer: 1 → B.

segments.src: Tekstur ditentukan oleh ukuran butiran mineral hasil pelapukan batuan induk, sehingga praktis permanen; struktur, bahan organik, dan pH semuanya bisa dikelola.
segments.tr: Texture is determined by the size of mineral grains resulting from parent rock weathering, making it practically permanent; structure, organic matter, and pH can all be managed.
2 → X (false).

segments.src: Topsoil adalah horizon A; horizon B adalah subsoil tempat liat dan hara hasil pencucian mengendap.
segments.tr: Topsoil is horizon A; horizon B is the subsoil where clay and leached nutrients accumulate.

segments.src: Kandungan liat adalah bagian dari tekstur dan tidak hilang karena pH rendah; tiga masalah lainnya justru ciri khas tanah masam tropis.*
segments.tr: Clay content is part of texture and does not disappear due to low pH; the other three problems are characteristics of tropical acidic soils.*
